Webhook ingress is public by necessity but signature-first. The signing secret is server-side only, expected in DIGIFORGE_ETSY_WEBHOOK_SECRET, never accepted from a request parameter, never displayed, and never stored in logs/chat. Replay window is 300 seconds and raw body is bounded. Supported lifecycle events currently include order.paid, order.canceled, order.shipped and order.delivered.

Production webhook readiness is currently CONFIGURATION_REQUIRED because the signing secret is not configured. Webhook configuration and Etsy subscription setup must use a safe server-side mechanism and current official Etsy documentation. Do not paste the secret into chat or commit it to the repository.

Digital-only lines do not require POD provider mapping. POD lines require unique approved mapping/binding. Hybrid cases must be handled explicitly and fail closed when product/listing/provider intent is ambiguous.

Order states requiring review must be persisted in the local order record, not merely returned in an API response. No automatic APPROVED transition is permitted. Shipment/delivery webhook evidence is informational and must not be treated as authoritative provider fulfillment authorization.

For Etsy digital orders, DigiForge should prove delivery configuration from persisted evidence: approved internal listing → confirmed Etsy CREATE_DRAFT identity → confirmed UPLOAD_FILE operation → positive external listing_file_id bound to the same listing. This proves that the listing was configured with a delivery file; it does not prove that a buyer downloaded the file. Buyer-download claims require separate provider evidence if ever supported.
